Investors now eagerly await new trial results comparing ivonescimab with conventional lung cancer therapies.

articles.desc: Sebi has established a sub-group within its Primary Market Advisory Committee aimed at reassessing regulations related to IPOs and fundraising. The initiative seeks to streamline compliance requirements to foster easier access to capital markets. Key focal points include promoter capital lock-in terms, pricing strategies, and due diligence obligations. The group will evaluate relevant Sebi circulars for potential modifications, with final recommendations to be presented to the PMAC for review.

articles.title: Retain capital gains tax on equities, economists tell FM Sitharaman ahead of Budget 2027-28
articles.desc: Economists recently met with Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to discuss the upcoming Union Budget for 2027-28. They recommended keeping the capital gains tax on equities, opposing industry requests for its abolition. Meeting discussions highlighted the economic improvements and private investment growth, emphasizing the importance of fiscal prudence. Additionally, they suggested boosting the MSME and labor-intensive sectors for employment opportunities.

articles.title: Blackstone REIT to buy majority stake in $5 billion Amazon data center portfolio
articles.desc: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust has officially announced its commitment to acquire a 75.1% stake in joint ventures alongside Amazon Web Services. This significant deal values the AWS data center portfolio at around $5 billion, marking a bold entry into the market. The portfolio features 13 newly constructed powered shells with long-term leases back to AWS.

articles.title: Warren Buffett donates $5.47 billion in Berkshire Hathaway shares to charities, confidence in successors remains 'strong as ever'
articles.desc: Warren Buffett announced a donation of approximately $5.47 billion in Berkshire Hathaway shares to various charities. This donation consists of 9,225,000 Class B shares allocated to four foundations. Following this contribution, he has donated over $29 billion of his Berkshire stock to those organizations. Despite the donation, Buffett retains around 13% of Berkshire's stock ownership. He remains confident in the leadership of the conglomerate he built over 60 years.

articles.title: India's sugar output more than doubles to 23.59 lakh tonnes by November 15
articles.desc: India has seen a significant rise in sugar production, reaching 23.59 lakh tonnes by November 15. This increase is attributed mainly to the early start of crushing operations in Maharashtra. Sugar mills in Maharashtra rose to 154, contributing 18.51 lakh tonnes of sugar production. Other states like Uttar Pradesh and Karnataka are gradually boosting their crushing activities.

articles.title: Sebi forms panel to simplify capital-raising rules
articles.desc: India's markets regulator has established a 10-member panel to review regulations concerning capital raising by companies. The panel, chaired by Ashish Chauhan of NSE, includes executives from various financial institutions. It will assess eligibility criteria, lock-in periods, and rules for securities allocation and allotment. Furthermore, the group will examine disclosure requirements for initial public offerings and follow-on offers. This initiative aims to simplify regulations and enhance access to capital markets.

articles.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slide as Nvidia earnings, Anthropic debut loom
articles.desc: As the U.S. stock futures stumble, AI-related companies find themselves under pressure, particularly ahead of Nvidia's anticipated earnings report. The recent leadership shift at Nvidia is casting shadows of uncertainty over the tech sector, affecting not just chipmakers but the broader market sentiment. Additionally, investors are looking toward Anthropic's entrance, which could reshape technology portfolios.

articles.title: India's investments in US Treasuries jump USD 38.4 bn in Jun-Aug amid FCNR flows
articles.desc: India's investment in US Treasury securities increased by USD 38.4 billion due to FCNR(B) deposits during three months. The Reserve Bank of India introduced a special facility to encourage these foreign currency deposits. This facility led to significant inflows, improving India's foreign exchange reserves substantially. Experts suggest that investment in US Treasuries may slow down due to the closure of the FCNR(B) window. India's reserves grew to USD 740.

articles.desc: Hong Kong stock exchange has introduced its inaugural benchmark for offshore yuan bonds to enhance global yuan usage. A dozen asset managers are set to utilize this index for new investment products. The initiative aligns with China's ongoing efforts to internationalize the yuan currency due to geopolitical factors. This launch builds on previous measures to boost the offshore yuan market and develop related infrastructure.

articles.title: India bonds dip as elevated inflation fuels rate hike expectations

The benchmark bond yield climbed slightly, mirroring movements in US Treasuries. In light of fresh inflation data, expectations have intensified for rate increases in both the US and India, leading analysts to modify their inflation outlook for an upcoming RBI meeting.

Analysts are wary about the impact of increasing interest rates, which could slow down new investments. Meanwhile, Nvidia's financial partners remain active in talks surrounding AI financing. A clear shift towards more traditional players may emerge, steering clear of the riskier neocloud investments.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley turns bullish on global stocks, targets S&P 500 at 8,700
articles.desc: Morgan Stanley has upgraded global equities to maximum overweight, citing favorable valuations for risk assets in the coming years. It projects an S&P 500 target of 8,700 for 2027, reflecting a significant increase from current levels. Earnings growth is anticipated to be the main driver for this expected rise, alongside stabilization in oil prices and interest rates.

November saw foreign equity inflows amounting to nearly $10 billion, reversing recent trends of outflows. Analysts highlighted that these inflows contributed to the rupee's stabilization amid expectations of potential US interest rate hikes. The Nifty 50 index also climbed by 0.6%, buoyed by limited exposure to AI trades.
